description: A single-panel X-ray diffraction figure in which two θ-2θ scans are overlaid and offset vertically: Intensity (a.u.) on the y-axis (no numeric ticks) against 2θ (°) on the x-axis, ticked from 40 to 110 in 10° steps. The legend at the top right identifies the black trace as M1-IA and the red trace as M2-IA. Reflections are labelled directly on the peaks: γ 111 (near 43°), α 110 (the most intense peak of both traces, near 44–45°), γ 200 (near 51°), α 200 (near 65°), γ 220 (near 75°), α 211 (near 82°), γ 311 (near 91°), γ 222 (near 96°) and α 220 (near 99°). Each trace carries a printed austenite fraction at its right-hand end: fγ = 45.6% for the black M1-IA pattern and fγ = 19.6% for the red M2-IA pattern. Both traces contain the same set of γ (fcc) and α (bcc) reflections, so both intercritically annealed samples are ferrite + austenite, and the figure's quantitative claim is that M1-IA retains more than twice as much austenite as M2-IA. No δ-ferrite-specific reflection is distinguished: every bcc peak is labelled simply α.

subfigures.description: The only panel: overlaid XRD patterns of M1-IA (black) and M2-IA (red), Intensity (a.u.) vs 2θ = 40–110°. Peaks labelled γ 111, α 110, γ 200, α 200, γ 220, α 211, γ 311, γ 222, α 220; α 110 dominates. Printed fγ = 45.6% beside the black trace and fγ = 19.6% beside the red trace.

observations.observation: The plot legend assigns the black trace to M1-IA and the red trace to M2-IA.
The x-axis is 2θ (°), spanning 40 to 110 with 10° major ticks; the y-axis is Intensity (a.u.) with no printed numeric scale.
The α 110 reflection is the most intense peak in both traces, located between the 40 and 50 ° marks.
Austenite reflections labelled on the patterns are γ 111, γ 200, γ 220, γ 311 and γ 222.
Ferrite reflections labelled on the patterns are α 110, α 200, α 211 and α 220.
A text label at the right end of the black (M1-IA) trace reads fγ = 45.6%.
A text label at the right end of the red (M2-IA) trace reads fγ = 19.6%.
Both traces show the same set of α and γ reflections, indicating that both intercritically annealed samples consist of ferrite plus austenite.
No separate δ-ferrite reflection is labelled; every bcc peak is annotated only as α, so the figure itself does not visually discriminate δ-ferrite.
The caption states that the figure shows XRD plots for the M1-IA and M2-IA samples.
The citing text states that quantitative phase analysis gives M1-IA and M2-IA 45% and 19% austenite respectively, consistent with the printed fγ = 45.6% and fγ = 19.6%.
The citing text states that δ-ferrite is observed only in the M2-IA sample, a phase the XRD panel does not separately resolve because it is labelled as α.
